wiki.title: Erika Uyterhoeven
wiki.extract: Erika Uyterhoeven (; born July 26, 1986) is a member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 27th Middlesex district and a Massachusetts State Senate candidate for the 2nd Middlesex district. Uyterhoeven is a member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA). Prior to serving in elected office, Uyterhoeven was a political activist and antitrust economist.
